lesson: The system consistently attempted to front-run reversals against strong momentum, resulting in six consecutive stop-outs as price ignored oversold/overbought signals. The reliance on low-confidence setups (avg 43%) during clear trend continuations indicates a failure to respect the dominant market structure.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend-Filter Rule' that mandates a minimum 60% confidence threshold and prohibits counter-trend entries until a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Upthrust is validated on the 4H timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on XRP during high-volatility trend phases.
